visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) On a wide, lush green grassy field, several men are dressed in elaborate Roman legionary costumes, including chainmail shirts, metallic helmets, and red tunics. They hold round wooden shields and practice swinging wooden swords. A man wearing modern black casual clothes stands centrally, holding a professional video camera to document the scene while a yellow plastic cone marks a boundary on the grass. (2) The camera shifts to a different angle, revealing a disciplined line of soldiers carrying large, red rectangular scutum shields. These shields feature distinctive white crescent and star patterns with a central metal boss. The men stand in formation, their silver helmets glinting under the bright, natural daylight as the camera slowly pans across the row of shields. (3) Action sequences show participants clashing in mock combat, with swords striking against shields in a choreographed manner. A man dressed in a striking red cape and a unique headdress made from a wolf's pelt raises a long, curved brass horn known as a bucina to his lips. In the foreground, another man in a centurion-style uniform with a prominent red crest on his helmet holds a black microphone. (4) The reenactment continues with various groups of men in armor running and engaging each other across the park grounds. The camera work is dynamic, using handheld pans and tracking shots to follow the movement. Other participants in colorful tunics, some red and some yellow, are seen moving through the background, adding to the chaotic energy of the simulated battlefield. (5) The screen transitions to a stark black background where large, stylized Chinese characters in yellow and white are displayed. The text occupies the central portion of the frame, serving as a concluding title card or a punchline to the preceding energetic footage. No further visual activity or people are shown during this final graphic sequence.
